title: Prove the browser-only fresh start: journey, copy, docs
description:

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the proof that the capability children A-C shipped actually works from a browser against a real daemon, plus every sentence in the repo that currently says it does not.

MEASURED AT 68eb1c5d - the exact doc anchors (the parent DoD's wording does not match the tree; use THESE):
- apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts:91-93 - the sentence to delete is split across lines and ends `+ " seed); the browser cannot drive the pre-activation chain.";`. The parent DoD's grep (`grep -n "cannot drive the pre-activation chain" <file>` = 0 matches) is satisfiable as written.
- README.md:88-91 - the 'What this is not' sentence reads "a fresh project cannot be started from the browser alone (goal creation waits on the project activation chain, which the seed script or the wrapper drives)". Also re-date the "Measured on 2026-09-03" stamp on line 88.
- docs/agent-stack-runbook.md:47-52 - the paragraph is `**New Goal** remains disabled until the project ledger contains legitimate durable repository, provider, distribution, backup, credential, and store receipts. The current fresh-project browser flow has no production writer for that complete receipt set...`. NOTE: the parent DoD calls this the "New Goal remains disabled" paragraph, but the literal string in the file is bolded markdown - `grep -n "New Goal" docs/agent-stack-runbook.md` finds it at :47. Do not chase the unbolded string; it does not exist.
- The e2e lane is REAL and already drives a daemon: tests/e2e/control-room/ with playwright.config.ts, `pnpm test:e2e:browser` = `tsc -p tests/e2e/control-room/tsconfig.json && playwright test -c ...` (package.json:22). daemon-ports.ts exports `withDaemonBackedControlRoom` and lane options `seed: "NONE"` / `approval: "HUMAN"` - board-chain.spec.ts:1-33 documents the idiom and is the model to copy.
- IMPORTANT: board-chain.spec.ts drives the LEGACY dev board (`cr.liveboard.*` testids, DEV_PAYLOADS). The new journey must drive the V2 surface - the Activate card child C shipped - or it proves the old path, not the product.
- tests/e2e/control-room/tsconfig.json CANNOT reach into apps/ (TS6059), so expected strings are HAND-TRANSCRIBED from the modules that produce them; deriving them from those modules would make the assertions self-referential. Follow board-chain.spec.ts:35-43's stated reasoning.

NOT IN SCOPE: changing production behaviour. If the journey finds a defect, that is a finding to report against child A/B/C - not a fix to smuggle in here.
definitionOfDone: A Playwright journey under tests/e2e/control-room/ drives, against a REAL daemon with `seed: "NONE"` (no fixtures, empty store): browser-only register -> Activate project -> New Goal enabled -> goal.create_with_source ACCEPTED. `pnpm test:e2e:browser` quoted with its count line. `grep -n "cannot drive the pre-activation chain" apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts` returns 0 matches at the delivered tree, and the replacement copy names the Activate card; live-goal-create's own test is updated so the new copy is asserted, not merely absent.

taskRails: PROVE IT LIVE: an offline e2e over a REAL daemon is necessary but NOT sufficient - the completion must also record a live drive (transcript, store path, sha) in a row comment. Never restart the wrapper to unstick a seat (claim TTL 30 min).

Follow both. THE CRITICAL DIFFERENCE FROM board-chain.spec.ts: it navigates to `${lane.baseUrl}?v1=1` (:424), and that `?v1=1` param is what serves the LEGACY dev board with its fake DEV_PAYLOADS witness. This journey must navigate to `lane.baseUrl` with NO `v1` param so the V2 app is served — a journey that clicks `cr.liveboard.*` re-proves the pre-existing fake-witness path and certifies nothing. Read `pairing-operator-channel.spec.ts` for how a v2 lane reaches a paired session, and `daemon-ports.ts:376-390` for `DaemonLaneOptions` (`approval`, `liveCredentials`, `seed`, the operator channel).

LANE FACTS CONFIRMED (all as the plan states them):
- board-chain.spec.ts:436 `page.goto(`${lane.baseUrl}?v1=1`)`; main.tsx:101 `params.get("v1") === "1"` serves DevelopmentLegacyRoot, so bare `lane.baseUrl` serves V2 Cordum. The `?v1=1` trap is real.

THE BLOCKER (defect in child C task-0a5d7212, filed as a comment there):
`createActivationReadPort` (apps/daemon/src/http/activation-read.ts:182) has ZERO production callers. `grep -rn "createActivationReadPort" apps/ packages/ | grep -v '\.test\.'` returns ONLY its own definition line. daemon-entry.ts:263-311 spreads 25 optional listener deps (affordances, runs, policy, health, activity, sessions, repositoryRemote, goalSource, graph, goalCatalog, planningRuns, budgetCommitment, ...) and `activation` is NOT among them, so `StartListenerOptions.activation` (http-listener.ts:145) is always undefined and handleActivationReadRequest (activation-read.ts:236) takes the `port === undefined` branch.

LIVE PROBE against the REAL production boot (`daemon-main.ts --dependencies=apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-dependencies.ts --port=0`), same env shape as daemonEnv(), headers copied from live-config.ts:94-99:
  POST /activation/read  -> HTTP 503 {"code":"LISTENER_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE","layer":"CONTROL_ROOM_LISTENER"}
  POST /affordances/read -> HTTP 200 {"nextAllowedCommands":[policy.install, project.register, session.open], "outcome":"SURFACE", ...}
So the surface plane the chain needs is healthy; only the receipts read is unwired. Full probe source is inline in the comment on task-0a5d7212.

WHY THIS KILLS THE ROW'S DoD, not just one assertion: live-activation.ts decodes that exact 2-key body via `exactDataRecord(response,["code","layer"])` into `status:"REFUSED"`, and ActivateScreen (activation-screen.tsx:113-124) EARLY-RETURNS on `outcome.status !== "ACTIVATION"`, rendering only `cr.activate.refusal`. `cr.activate.button` is never mounted. So from a real daemon the browser cannot render receipts and cannot drive the chain — DoD 1 (journey), DoD 4 (live drive) and DoD 7 (adversarial pass over Activate) are all unreachable, and DoD 2/3 would have me write copy and README/runbook prose asserting a browser-only fresh start that demonstrably does not work. Row rail 2 forbids me fixing it here ("a hardening row that edits what it certifies proves nothing").

The dev proxy is NOT the problem: dev-proxy-paths.ts:6 already carries "/activation/read".
The fix is small and its inputs already exist: `activationReceiptInput(projectId, env, cwd)` is exported (activation-command-entry.ts:66) and already used by daemon-command-registry.ts:40.

THE JOURNEY FOUND A REAL PRODUCT DEFECT AND THE ROW'S CENTRAL CLAIM IS FALSE AT HEAD. Reporting, not patching (row rail 2). Filed as task-d342a2b158764fefa8dbf2a5365e7bf7; evidence on the owning row task-3506e04a as comment-f64e380c.

THE FAILURE, live, real daemon, `seed: "NONE"`:
  `Activate the project - refused ACTIVATION_POLICY_UNMEASURED @ DAEMON_ACTIVATION_RECEIPTS`
`cr.activate.step.project.activate` carries data-ok="false"; register, bind_repository and provider.probe all carry "true". CAUSE: ACTIVATION_CHAIN_KINDS (activation-port.ts:29) mirrors COMMAND_PREREQUISITES["project.activate"] (bootstrap-sequence.ts:31-35), which omits policy.install — but the activation witness measures the policy receipt as the digest of the INSTALLED SLICE SET (activation-receipts.ts:38), so with nothing installed there is nothing to measure. My /activation/read probe returned blocking:["provider","policy"]; provider.probe clears provider and NOTHING clears policy. demo-seed-plan.ts:91-95 documents this exact refusal — task-4b9c394d made the receipt load-bearing and updated DEMO_SEED_KINDS but not COMMAND_PREREQUISITES. Every other lane seeds, so only `seed: "NONE"` exposes it, and this row's DoD is the only thing that ever demanded one.

FOUR REAL BUGS IN MY OWN SPEC, each fixed from measured output, recorded so nobody re-finds them:
1. `liveCredentials: "ATTACHED"` does NOT pair the tab — the page rendered "Moe was started without a terminal it can listen on" and cr.activate.root never mounted. Needs `operatorChannel: true` plus the real handshake (publish-remote.spec.ts:73-88).
2. New Goal is NOT disabled pre-activation. `createDisabledReason` (cordum-app.tsx:364) derives ONLY from the connection descriptor; `goalCreateRefusal` has ONE production consumer, live-goal-create.ts:215, which runs on SUBMIT. So DoD 1's "assert New Goal is BLOCKED" describes a product that does not exist. The arm now drives the form and asserts the daemon's refusal in the create report — strictly stronger, and it exercises the copy step 4 rewrote at its only real call site.
3. `cr.goals.newgoal.prd.input` is `type="file"`; `.fill()` throws. Uses setInputFiles now — and it must be a real attachment or the browser sends brief-only `goal.create` instead of `goal.create_with_source`.
4. `cr.goals.newgoal.prd.status` states the browser-computed sha256, not the filename. Asserted against a sha256 taken in the spec, which proves the bytes were read client-side.

WHAT THE SPEC PROVED BEFORE IT FAILED: seedPid null; real pairing; card mounts with cr.activate.refusal absent; cr.activate.reason.repository contains the lane's real `git rev-parse HEAD`; no receipt reads as `<projectId>-*`; a pre-activation create is REFUSED with the new copy (old sentence asserted absent from the LIVE surface); three of four chain steps green.

PARKED, NOT WEAKENED. The spec lands with a single `test.fixme(true, "blocked on task-d342a2b1...")` as its first statement — `npx playwright test ... activation-fresh-project` => `1 skipped`, EXIT 0.
